title: Zapier Team to self-hosted Activepieces
summary: Zapier Team is $828 a year before you exceed a single task allowance. That is where self-hosted automation starts to make sense.

you_lose: Zapier's integration catalogue, which is an order of magnitude larger
Someone else repairing an integration when a vendor changes their API
Zapier's reliability record on unattended overnight runs
you_gain: Unmetered task volume, which is the entire argument
A visual builder close enough to Zapier's that the team does not have to relearn it
Pieces written in TypeScript that you can extend yourself

caveats: Activepieces uses the MIT licence for its core with some enterprise features held back. Check which side of that line the features you need fall on.
The $69 Zapier figure is its entry tier. If you are on Team because of task volume rather than seats, your real bill is higher and this comparison understates the saving.
There is no automated import. Every workflow is rebuilt by hand.
